ValidationRule.description: If HR Result = Approve, Approved Requested Card Type = ila Switch and Segment = Staff
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.LastName <> 'Integration', ISBLANK(cc_Approved_Balance_Transfer_Amount__c), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card"), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(cc_HR_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_HR_Result__c,'Approved') ), AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c,'Accept') ) ), TEXT(cc_Approved_Requested_Card_Type__c ) = 'PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Approve Balance Transfer Amount field.
